# Eirvan Foods® - Natural Goodness • Better Tomorrow

> Eirvan Foods® is Pakistan's premier purveyor of single-origin dry fruits, wholesome mountain nuts, cold stone-ground superfood powders, and bespoke artisanal gift hampers. Ethically gathered from Kashmir, Gilgit-Baltistan, Balochistan, and Al-Madinah.

## Overview
Eirvan Foods (Natural Goodness • Better Tomorrow) delivers premium culinary and wellness dry fruits across Pakistan with nationwide Cash on Delivery (COD), Direct Bank Transfer, and State Bank Raast payments. All products are 100% pure, natural, and preservative-free, packaged in vacuum-sealed food-grade containers preserving delicate natural oils and freshness.

## Product Collections
- [Single-Origin Nuts](/): Hand-cracked Kashmiri Mamra almonds (52% natural oil), high-altitude Gilgit-Baltistan soft-shell walnuts, King W180 cashews, and roasted salted Irani pistachios.
- [Artisan Dry Fruit Powders & Panjiri](/): Cold stone-ground organic nutrition formulations, including Shahi Royal Panjiri and high-protein infant/elderly wellness blends.
- [Dates & Vine-Dried Raisins](/): Authentic Madinah Ajwa dates, Medjool dates, and sun-cured Kandahari golden Sundarkhani raisins.
- [Curated Mixed Fruit Blends](/): Daily vitalizing combinations of premium mountain nuts, dried fruits, and seeds for students, athletes, and daily wellness.
- [Artisan Gift Box Builder](/): Bespoke Chiniot handcrafted pinewood chests and royal olive linen hampers with customizable dry fruit selections, satin ribbons, and personalized calligraphy cards.

## Sourcing & Quality Standards
- Single-Origin Kashmiri Mamra Badam: Authentic concave-grooved Mamra almonds with exceptional oil concentration.
- Gilgit Kagzi Walnuts: Organically grown in high Himalayan valleys without chemical pesticides or bleaching.
- Cold Stone-Milling: Stone-ground at minimal rotational friction to preserve volatile oils, minerals, and antioxidants.
- Freshness Integrity: Nitrogen-flushed and vacuum-sealed packaging with food-grade moisture absorbers ensuring 12-month shelf life.

## Nationwide Pakistan Delivery & Orders
- Geographic Coverage: Complete nationwide courier delivery across Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Quetta, Multan, Faisalabad, and all remote districts.
- Shipping Timelines: 24 to 48 hours for Lahore and Islamabad/Rawalpindi; 2 to 4 business days nationwide via express courier (TCS / Leopard).
- Delivery Charges: Flat PKR 250; FREE nationwide shipping on all orders over PKR 3,500.
- Payment Methods: Cash on Delivery (COD), State Bank Raast ID (03176369458), and Direct Bank Transfer (Meezan Bank, HBL, Bank Alfalah).
